title: Small Business Tax Tracker 2026
tagline: Income, expenses, mileage & quarterly taxes in one spreadsheet. 2026 IRS rates built in.
description: Works in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets — instant digital download
11 tabs including Dashboard, Income, Expenses, Mileage Log, Quarterly Estimated Taxes, Home Office, Tax Summary, Settings and Instructions
Expenses sorted into Schedule C categories automatically
Mileage log with 2026 IRS rates built in: 72.5¢/mile (Jan–Jun) and 76¢/mile (Jul–Dec)
Quarterly estimated tax calculator, including self-employment tax (15.3% on 92.35% of net)
Home office deduction using the simplified method: $5 per sq ft, up to 300 sq ft
Year-end Tax Summary ready to hand to your tax preparer
note: This template is an organizational tool, not tax advice. Consult a qualified tax professional.
